constraints.text: Security: secrets stay in env or config and are never inlined, logged or returned; the current migrate_config copies a key value into apiconf's file, which the env-only design removes.
Principle VIII: config changes additively with a migration in the same change; existing installs move through migrate-config.

prismis already loads ~/.config/prismis/.env with python-dotenv, and cerebro's systemd unit also sets EnvironmentFile=/home/rudy/.config/prismis/.env, so environment-only keys need no new loading mechanism.
Probed 2026-10-07: a first run on an empty config home leaves verify failing on the missing services.toml, and migrate-config reports 'Nothing to do'.
llm_client.py's docstring: services.toml is shared with eight other apps that still use llm-core, so it must stay readable and unwritten by prismis.
config.toml already resolves `env:NAME` values (expand_env_var) for Reddit credentials, the form the API keys will use.
Keyless local servers are already supported (key_required = false), so a service with no api_key must keep working.
The README already documents the `api_key = "env:VARIABLE_NAME"` pattern for prismis config.

apiconf's provider mapping names the variables `apiconf env` exports: openai -> OPENAI_API_KEY, otherwise PROVIDER_API_KEY (openrouter -> OPENROUTER_API_KEY); the apiconf CLI is not installed on the Mac or cerebro, and cerebro has cargo.
Production (cerebro) runs prismis-light and prismis-deep on OpenRouter with openai/gpt-5.4-nano and prismis-kind on OpenRouter's Decisions endpoint; every LLM test recording uses openai/gpt-5.4-nano.
